title: C#
label: C#
desc: Statically typed .NET language with LINQ, async/await, and a large standard library.

sections.title: Setup
sections.description: Install the SDK, scaffold a project, and build, run, and publish it.

snippets.code:
# List the installed SDKs; 10.0 is the current LTS line
dotnet --list-sdks

# Scaffold a console project in its own folder
dotnet new console -n Greeter --framework net10.0
cd Greeter

# Restore, build and run
dotnet run

# Run every test project in the solution
dotnet test

# Publish a self-contained binary for linux-x64
dotnet publish -c Release -r linux-x64 --self-contained true -o out

<Project Sdk="Microsoft.NET.Sdk">
  <PropertyGroup>
    <OutputType>Exe</OutputType>
    <TargetFramework>net10.0</TargetFramework>
    <ImplicitUsings>enable</ImplicitUsings>
    <Nullable>enable</Nullable>
    <TreatWarningsAsErrors>true</TreatWarningsAsErrors>
  </PropertyGroup>
</Project>

sections.title: Entity Framework Core
sections.description: Model a database, query it, save changes, and run migrations.

snippets.code:
# Add the provider and the design-time package to the project
dotnet add package Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Sqlite
dotnet add package Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Design

# Install the EF command-line tool once
dotnet tool install --global dotnet-ef

# Create a migration from the current model and apply it
dotnet ef migrations add InitialCreate
dotnet ef database update

# Inspect the migration history
dotnet ef migrations list

sections.title: Testing
sections.description: xUnit facts, theories, and filtered test runs.

snippets.code:
# Run every test project in the solution
dotnet test

# Narrow to one test class, then to one method
dotnet test --filter "FullyQualifiedName~CalculatorTests"
dotnet test --filter "FullyQualifiedName~CalculatorTests.Divide_ByZero_Throws"

# Collect coverage when coverlet.collector is referenced
dotnet test --collect:"XPlat Code Coverage"
